candidate.title: The description does not say why the timeout changed from 30s to 5s
candidate.finding: The timeout drops from 30 s to 5 s with no stated reason. State in the description why 5 s is enough; that explanation settles this finding.

replies.text: Added to the description: the upstream API's p99 is 800 ms, and callers hit the 30 s timeout only when the upstream is down, where a fast failure is what we want. 5 s is six times the p99.
